# Team deploy notes

Draft the deploy notes for one release from its merged PRs and their tickets, in the format of
`reference/format.md`. Read each ticket through ai-dlc's tracker role (`tracker_get`), never a vendor's tool.

Post nothing: a person reviews the draft and posts it. Questions go to {{owner}}.

{{wall}}
